top_signals.title: Anwar’s Daughter Takes Leave from Party Leadership Amid Setbacks
top_signals.summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s daughter has sought to relinquish her role as deputy president of his party, more than a year after her election fueled accusations of nepotism and exposed deep divisions within the ruling coalition.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
